snippet.title: "Concord Ode" 2nd Anniversary Update Trailer丨Snowbreak: Containment Zone
snippet.description:
The bells of celebration echo, laughter filling the halls.
The ancient academy slowly sinks into a mire of illusions.
The ring of vows weaves love into verses of poetry,
only our tightly held hands can rewrite the final hymn.

See You at Civilization's End.
Snowbreak: Containment Zone 2nd Anniversary Update "Concord Ode" available on 7/10 (UTC+8)! Please stay tuned.
